name: Tavily
summary: 实时联网搜索、网页正文提取与多源深度研究。
description: Tavily 官方 MCP 服务：联网搜索、正文提取、站内爬取与映射、多源深度研究。授权时在浏览器登录 Tavily，令牌只保存在本机。
examples: 搜索最近一周关于【固态电池量产】的新闻，按可信度排序并给出出处
把这个页面提取成干净正文，去掉导航和广告
梳理 example.com 的站点结构，列出所有文档链接
调研【企业级 RAG 方案】，对比三种做法的成本和效果

help.label: 查看 Tavily MCP 说明
help.hint: 授权时在浏览器登录 Tavily；额度按账号套餐计，令牌只保存在本机。

en.summary: Real-time web search, page extraction, and multi-source research.
en.description: Official Tavily MCP service: web search, content extraction, site crawling and mapping, and multi-source research. Sign in to Tavily in the browser; the token stays on this machine.
examples: Search the last week of news about solid-state battery production, rank by credibility, and cite sources
Extract clean body text from this page without navigation or ads
Map example.com and list all documentation links
Research enterprise RAG options and compare cost and results for three approaches
